🎵 TikTok draft ready: I knocked him out. They called it a draw.
Open TikTok > inbox notification, add a trending sound, paste:

I knocked him out. They called it a draw.

I was 16. My first fight, his sixth, and the ref knew him.
The guy who got me the fight told me: if it goes to points, you lose.

So we clinch. Elbow to the top of his head. The ref steps in, I throw the right hand. He's out.

They called it a draw.

My coaches said the elbows were legal. Some people say the right hand came too early.

KO or draw? You be the judge 👇

Send this to the guy in your gym who'd have lost his mind.

#fighter #muaythai #fightmindset
